root_text: 500 hospitals have gone bankrupt in China in 2024.  This despite the fact China is getting hit by a number of nasty respiratory viruses, including the apparently novel HMPV, which are resulting in hospitals being flooded with patients.

nodes.text: 500 hospitals have gone bankrupt in China in 2024.  This despite the fact China is getting hit by a number of nasty respiratory viruses, including the apparently novel HMPV, which are resulting in hospitals being flooded with patients.

nodes.author: EricMertz_KC
nodes.text: Nearly half of all hospitals in China are operating in severe debt, with wages being withheld an average of one month despite requiring workers to continue working.

nodes.author: EricMertz_KC
nodes.text: Several of the hospitals which went under hadn't paid wages for up to ten months - with the workers continuing to show up and work.

nodes.author: EricMertz_KC
nodes.text: Outside of the medical industry, we have seen an increase in sabotage by employees due to long term delays on wage payment among blue collar workers.
